approved_decisions.C1: A2 signals reference existing A1 criteria and traceable evidence.
approved_decisions.C2: A2 may propose evidence status and direction only; points, score and band are prohibited.
approved_decisions.C3: A2 human approval is required before a return to A1.
approved_decisions.C4: Manual no-integration returns stop at prepared and cannot claim delivery or receipt.
approved_decisions.C5: A1 alone validates evidence and produces numeric score revisions.
approved_decisions.C6: Criterion changes, configured weights and score delta reconcile deterministically.
approved_decisions.C7: A1 human review is required before a revision becomes approved/current.
approved_decisions.C8: Rejected signals do not change the score and remain auditable.
approved_decisions.C9: Original and later score revisions remain immutable; supersession is operational only.
approved_decisions.C10: Retries are idempotent and require matching IDs, hashes and receipts.
